user.title: Entertainment Profiler
user.description: Pick the receiver (optional, used to detect the active input) and every entity a profile should remember and restore, for example the receiver's volume and sound mode, a subwoofer level and switch, or lights.

data_description.receiver: A media player whose `source` attribute tells which input is active. Leave empty if you do not need it.
data_description.controls: Media players (volume and sound mode), numbers, switches, selects and lights.

abort.already_configured: A profiler with this name already exists.

sources_menu.title: Sources
sources_menu.description: The first source that matches wins, so add the most specific ones first.

add_source.title: Add source
add_source.description: A source says when an app or input is active and where the title comes from.

data.label: Name (e.g. Plex, Netflix, SmartTube)
data.receiver_source: Active only if the receiver input is
data.require_playing: Active only while the player is playing

data_description.receiver_source: Optional. Leave empty to use only the player state.
data_description.title_mode: With a title every series or movie gets its own profile, otherwise one profile per source.
data_description.require_playing: Switch off if the receiver input alone decides (the player may be idle).
data_description.learn: Store your manual changes as the profile of this source.
data_description.apps: Optional. Compared with the player's `app_name` attribute, e.g. when an Apple TV plays several apps. Empty = any app.
data_description.title_attribute: If the value is empty or just a year (common for movies), the media title is used.

data.label: Name (e.g. Plex, Netflix, SmartTube)
data.receiver_source: Active only if the receiver input is
data.require_playing: Active only while the player is playing

data_description.apps: Optional. Compared with the player's `app_name` attribute, e.g. when an Apple TV plays several apps. Empty = any app.
data_description.title_attribute: If the value is empty or just a year (common for movies), the media title is used.

data.key_debounce: Wait before a change is accepted
data.learn_stable: Learn after values were unchanged for
data.key_stable: Learn only after the same title played for
data.settle_timeout: Wait for the receiver to reach the volume
data.idle_label: Name of the idle profile (empty = off)
data.notify_apply: Notify when a profile is applied
data.notify_learn: Notify when a profile is learned
data.key_with_label: Include the app name in the key (App|Title)

data_description.key_stable: Prevents automatic changes right after a title started from being learned.
data_description.idle_label: Used when the receiver is on but no source matches. It is never learned.
data_description.key_with_label: Off: the key is only the title, so a series shares one profile across all apps. Without a title the app name stays the key.

error.label_pipe: The name must not contain the | character.

save_profile.name: Save profile
save_profile.description: Stores a profile. Without values the current values of all controlled entities are saved.

values.name: Values
values.description: Mapping entity_id to value. Default: current values.

apply_profile.name: Apply profile
apply_profile.description: Applies the profile of a key (default: what is playing now).

import_profiles.name: Import profiles
import_profiles.description: Stores many profiles at once, for example when migrating from another setup.
